description: The Lambda Studio component catalogue: every ready piece a Taifoon Lambda or a studio flow may be built from, native (coord RPC, the stream, the carriers, the vault signer guard, the Pons v2 venue, the market makers, the solver) and borrowed (Relay, LI.FI, Across, deBridge, Mayan, GOAT plugins, AgentKit, x402, Pons and pump.fun references), each with its source, licence, reuse mode (code · api · reference: code only under a permissive licence), the chains it serves and where it plugs into Taifoon. Filters: ?kind= ?chain= ?native=1. Returns: { schema, rule, order[], items{ <id>: { id, name, kinds[], native, chains[], source{ repo, license, ref?, paths?[], stars?, pushed? }, reuse, taifoon[], state, note? } } }. (GET /v1/lambda/components)

api_key.description: your tfr_ key (optional for keyless reads)

kind.description: components of one kind (quote, route, settle, release, venue, market-making, agent-tool, payment, read, stream, abi)

name: coord_lambda_components
